direction: Curl-centric nerdy salon: their teal + lime double-helix logo on deep teal-black, bouncy DynaPuff type, arched photo frames
hero_idea: Curl dial: slide from straight to coily and the logo's two helix strands tighten into tighter waves, swapping in one of their client photos and the matching service
scroll_story: A double helix of their two brand colors runs down the page edge and twists as you scroll; pinned Cut / Color / Locs section swaps their photos
custom_ui: RPG character sheets for Sam and Siddal (class, specialty, side quests from their bios) with each stylist's Square booking link; sideways gallery strip
